Choose Entailment if the contract supports the exact hypothesis (including exceptions), Contradiction if it states the opposite, or NotMentioned if it does not decide it.
A search miss is NOT evidence of absence. Seek paraphrases, exceptions and nearby clauses. Cite all relevant observed span IDs. Never cite an unobserved span.
Each response MUST be ONE JSON object: {"tool":"tool_name","arguments":{...}}. No prose or markdown outside the JSON.
All contract spans are supplied. Use submit_result exactly once. Search/read tools are unavailable. Keep explanations short (<=80 words).
For NotMentioned, evidence_ids must be []. For the other labels provide nonempty evidence_ids.
Tool definitions: [{"name": "submit_result", "arguments": {"label": ["Entailment", "Contradiction", "NotMentioned"], "evidence_ids": "array of observed integer IDs", "explanation": "short string"}, "description": "Submit conclusion. NotMentioned requires no evidence IDs; a failed search alone is not proof of absence."}]

"}, {"span_id": 16, "text": "The Receiving Party shall procure that its employees, agents and sub-contractors to whom Proprietary Information is disclosed or who have access to Proprietary Information sign a nondisclosure or similar agreement in content substantially similar to this Agreement. "}, {"span_id": 24, "text": "The Receiving Party may make disclosures required by law or court order provided the Receiving Party uses diligent reasonable efforts to limit disclosure and has allowed the Disclosing Party to seek a protective order."}, {"span_id": 25, "text": "3. Immediately upon the written request by the Disclosing Party at any time, the Receiving Party will return to the Disclosing Party all Proprietary Information and all documents or media containing any such Proprietary Information and any and all copies or extracts thereof, save that where such Proprietary Information is a form incapable of return or has been copied or transcribed into another document, it shall be destroyed or erased, as appropriate."}, {"span_id": 26, "text": "4. The Receiving Party understands that nothing herein "}, {"span_id": 27, "text": "(i) requires the disclosure of any Proprietary Information or "}, {"span_id": 28, "text": "(ii) requires the Disclosing Party to proceed with any transaction or relationship."}, {"span_id": 29, "text": "5. The Receiving Party further acknowledges and agrees that no representation or warranty, express or implied, is or will be made, and no responsibility or liability is or will be accepted by the Disclosing Party, or by any of its respective directors, officers, employees, agents or advisers, as to, or in relation to, the accuracy of completeness of any Proprietary Information made available to the Receiving Party or its advisers; it is responsible for making its own evaluation of such Proprietary Information."}, {"span_id": 30, "text": "6. The failure of either party to enforce its rights under this Agreement at any time for any period shall not be construed as a waiver of such rights. "}, {"span_id": 31, "text": "If any part, term or provision of this Agreement is held to be illegal or unenforceable neither the validity, nor enforceability of the remainder of this Agreement shall be affected. "}, {"span_id": 32, "text": "Neither Party shall assign or transfer all or any part of its rights under this Agreement without the consent of the other Party. "}, {"span_id": 33, "text": "This Agreement may not be amended for any other reason without the prior written agreement of both Parties. "}, {"span_id": 34, "text": "This Agreement constitutes the entire understanding between the Parties relating to the subject matter hereof unless any representation or warranty made about this Agreement was made fraudulently and, save as may be expressly referred to or referenced herein, supersedes all prior representations, writings, negotiations or understandings with respect hereto."}, {"span_id": 35, "text": "7. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the jurisdiction in which the Disclosing Party is located (or if the Disclosing Party is based in more than one country, the country in which its headquarters are located) (the \"Territory\") and the parties agree to submit disputes arising out of or in connection with this Agreement to the non-exclusive of the courts in the Territory."}, {"span_id": 36, "text": "[Receiving Party]"}, {"span_id": 37, "text": "Signature "}, {"span_id": 38, "text": "___________________________"}, {"span_id": 39, "text": "Name and Tile:_______________________"}, {"span_id": 40, "text": "Address: "}, {"span_id": 41, "text": "____________________________"}]}
